title: Formalize Decision-Control-Execution Separation
objective: Accept the three-layer authority model, define Research Decision Contract v1, record code-confirmed V7 gaps, update project memory, and validate the architecture contract without implementing runtime services.
scope: ResearchDecision v1 contract, bounded JSON Schema, and valid example.
Architecture v1, ADR indexes, terminology, component, issue, roadmap, state, and handoff updates.
Bounded validator and targeted positive/negative document-contract tests.
One immutable Implementation Run and one local commit.
explicit_non_goals: No Skill runtime, Decision Validator code, Code Orchestrator v2, state machine, permission service, or budget service.
No database, API, DSL, Optimization, Validation, Registry, TDX, LightGBM, Qlib, Risk, UI, or other business implementation.
No Factor Lab modification, dependency installation, lockfile change, configuration change, or push.

known_limitations: This task creates architecture contracts only; no ResearchDecision domain model or runtime service exists.
Decision Validator, actor permission policy, Frozen Test enforcement, Skill runtime, and Code Orchestrator v2 are unimplemented.
Official V7 Factor Lab remains Python-first and does not consume ResearchDecision.
Runtime state, budget, idempotency, concurrency, retry, and recovery controls remain future implementation work.
The zero-dependency validator implements only the JSON Schema keywords used by local contracts and does not semantically validate date-time format.
The containing commit cannot be embedded self-referentially; Git history resolves it after commit.
unresolved_questions: What actor identity, authentication, delegation, and permission model will govern ResearchDecision?
What semantic fingerprint and persistent uniqueness rules will distinguish exact Decision replay from conflict?
Which visible-summary redaction policy will apply to restricted validation stages?
Which V7 donor capabilities will migrate behind the target control boundary and in what durable source location?
rollback_information: Revert the single containing commit. No database, data, API, runtime, model, Qlib, UI, dependency, lockfile, configuration, or Factor Lab rollback is required.
security_impact: The contract explicitly denies Agent direct execution, Registry mutation, budget expansion, and Frozen Test access; runtime enforcement remains unimplemented.
data_lineage_impact: No data changed; future Decision, Run, Result, visible summary, and memory identities are required to remain separate and lineage-bound.
